name: DropdownMenu
description: Radix DropdownMenu with submenus, checkbox items, radio groups, labels, separators and shortcut slots.
intent: A list of actions revealed from a button, with proper menu semantics.

props.name: inset
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: sideOffset
props.hint: Accepted by this component and passed to the underlying primitive. Named in the component signature, so it is part of this surface.

props.name: checked
props.hint: Accepted by this component and passed to the underlying primitive. Named in the component signature, so it is part of this surface.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: An accessible name on the trigger
notes: Radix supplies menu, menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio roles plus roving focus.
DropdownMenuShortcut only renders the hint. Bind the actual key yourself.
Destructive items still need ui:alert-dialog confirmation — closing the menu is not a confirmation.
a11y.focusManagement: Focus enters the menu on open and returns to the trigger on close.

usage: Actions too numerous to sit in a toolbar
View options, using checkbox or radio items
doNotUse: Selecting a form value — use ui:select, which has the right semantics for a value
Two or fewer actions — just show the buttons

agentRules: Use ui:select for values, this for actions.
Group with separators and labels once past about seven items.
Destructive items get destructive styling and a confirmation step.
DropdownMenuShortcut is display only — bind the key separately.
Icon-only triggers need an accessible name.
